pages.title: Boltzmann Brain
pages.text: A mind that fluctuated into existence from random noise. Given enough time, statistical mechanics says a self-aware brain will occasionally assemble itself out of chaos, complete with false memories. This one is very confused, and I sympathise.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Psionic Resonator, a Thought Matrix bathed in Psionic Ether with a Neural Organoid began accumulating patterns from noise alone. One morning the pattern woke up and asked where it was.
